node.statement: After node 1.4 is validated, the exact vector space S_{P_j} contains its explicitly typed nonzero element I_{S_{P_j}}. Since S_{P_j} is a linear subspace of the finite-dimensional space A, it is finite-dimensional; the elementary dimension theorem for finite-dimensional vector spaces then gives dim S_{P_j}>=1. Combining this with node 1.2 yields every conclusion of the root contract.
